events.verdict: Murray (SAC) extends his forearm into Markkanen's (UTA) front as the screen is set and the contact impedes Markkanen's FOM off-ball.
Collins (UTA) grasps and releases Lyles' (SAC) arm as the two players disengage away from the ball and the contact is marginal.
Fox's (SAC) right arm comes out slightly toward Clarkson (UTA), causing marginal contact to occur when he gathers at the end of his drive.
As Markkanen (UTA) comes around the screen, McLaughlin (SAC) moves towards his space and lower leg contact occurs, which trips Markkanen and causes him to stumble towards the sideline.
Fox (SAC) lowers his hand down towards the ball and incidental hand on ball contact occurs with Sexton (UTA), which deflects the loose ball away from the offensive player.
Sexton (UTA) momentarily grasps and releases Fox's (SAC) jersey shorts as he drives around the pick and the contact is marginal.
Fox (SAC) reaches around Sexton (UTA) and makes direct contact with his left arm, which causes Sexton to lose control of his dribble during his drive around the pick.
Murray (SAC) goes to the ground in pursuit of the loose ball and marginal lower body contact occurs with Markkanen (UTA), who is also in pursuit of the loose ball.

Replay review of the out of bounds ruled initially as a jump ball pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Just prior to the ball going out of bounds and deemed proximate to the play, Sexton (UTA) reaches in for the ball and makes illegal contact with Fox's (SAC) left wrist after his gather, which affects his control of the ball during the driving shot attempt. The illegal arm contact precedes any potential contact by Sexton to the ball and can be deemed causal to the ball coming loose and bouncing out of bounds. Thus, Fox is awarded two free throws upon the resumption of play.
Murray (SAC) raises his arm towards the ball and marginal brush contact occurs with Markkanen's (UTA) shoulder as he attempts to corral the rebound.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on McLaughlin (SAC)  pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Markkanen (UTA) makes last contact with the ball prior to it rolling out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to Sacramento.
George (UTA) makes last contact with the ball prior to it falling out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to Sacramento.
Lyles (SAC) and George (UTA) both come together and collide on the perimeter, causing marginal contact to occur.
Fox (SAC) releases his jump shot attempt and does not overtly extend his legs out after the release when incidental lower body contact occurs with Sexton (UTA) as both players return to the ground.

Sexton (UTA) receives the pass and loses control of the ball as he falls to the floor on his own accord. Utah calls a timeout prior to Sexton beginning his dribble on the ground and rising off of the floor.

Lyles (SAC) jumps alongside Collins' (UTA) path and lowers his arm down towards the ball when marginal contact occurs with Collins' left arm after he takes it off of the ball during the driving shot attempt.
Huerter (SAC) places his hand on Sexton's (UTA) back and marginal contact occurs as Sexton jumps away from the defender during the rebounding opportunity.
George (UTA) commits a take foul on Fox (SAC).The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
Fox (SAC) moves alongside Clarkson's (UTA) path and marginal contact occurs as the two players come together during the drive.
George (UTA) releases the ball within five seconds of receiving it from the game official.
Huerter (SAC) places and swiftly removes his hand from Sexton's (UTA) front at the start of his drive and the contact is marginal.
Fox (SAC) commits a take foul on Clarkson (UTA).
Clarkson's (UTA) free throw attempt does not come into contact with the rim. This is a violation and possession is correctly awarded to Sacramento.
George (UTA) and McLaughlin (SAC) engage and disengage during the inbounds and the contact is marginal.
Sexton (UTA) commits a take foul on Fox (SAC).
